facts.label: Palm Jebel Ali: construction contracts for 544 villas
facts.note: Nakheel reports contracts exceeding AED 3.5 billion: 354 villas on Fronds A-D and 190 on E-F. Award value is construction expenditure, not property prices or realised appreciation.
facts.identityBasis: Primary announcement explicitly names Palm Jebel Ali and the specified fronds or planned retail destination. No assignment to an individual villa phase.

facts.label: Fronds A-F contract scope: completion target Q4 2028
facts.note: Target applies to this 544-villa contract scope, not the whole island or initial K-P handovers. Delivery and supply can affect demand, but no price coefficient is inferred.
facts.identityBasis: Primary announcement explicitly names Palm Jebel Ali and the specified fronds or planned retail destination. No assignment to an individual villa phase.

facts.label: The Yard retail and lifestyle destination announced
facts.note: Planned destination: about 70,000 sqft gross leasable area and 26 retail, dining, wellness and healthcare concepts. Announced brands include Waitrose, American Hospital and Jumeirah International Nursery. Expected catchment is not measured resident population.
facts.identityBasis: Primary announcement explicitly names Palm Jebel Ali and the specified fronds or planned retail destination. No assignment to an individual villa phase.

facts.label: The Yard planned opening in 2027
facts.note: Planned year only; no actual opening, operating amenity or proven property-price increase claimed.
